meta.title: Joukowsky Dynamics Rev 08 — wheel-to-proprotor flying car
meta.basis: Builds on the A1-road baseline (Rev 07 concept CAD). Exterior lofted from A1 body surfaces.
meta.frame: +X forward, +Y up, +Z port; metres (STEP / BOM in millimetres)
meta.status: Concept CAD for design exploration. Not a flight-qualified design: no certified loads, fatigue, aeroelastic, crash or fault-tolerance substantiation.
